[[Classic Castle]] |animations = 1 }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|You cannot comprehend the power I possess!|'''1x1x1x1''' on Wave 12 of [[Classic Castle]]}} }} ==Description== '''1x1x1x1''' is the main narrator for the maps [[Classic Candy Cane Lane]], [[Classic Winter]], [[Classic Forest Camp]], [[Classic Island Chaos]] and [[Classic Castle]] during [[The Classic Event]]. ==Appearance== '''1x1x1x1''' has black skin and glowing red eyes. His torso is translucent green with a ribcage inside. He wears a green domino crown. ==Trivia== *'''1x1x1x1''' states that he personally knew multiple of the bosses that appear on the final waves on modes. **'''1x1x1x1''' was roommates with [[Korblox Deathwalker (The Classic)|Korblox Deathwalker]] in college. **The [[Grave Digger]] was one of his camping buddies. **The second [[Korblox Deathwalker (The Classic)|Korblox Deathwalker]] is the older brother of the first [[Korblox Deathwalker (The Classic)|Korblox Deathwalker]]. *'''1x1x1x1''' is an account that was created by Shedletsky, formerly Telamon. Throughout the community, many rumors spread about 1x1x1x1 being a "hacker". **The remade 1x1x1x1 account was created in August of 2010 by user [[w:c:Roblox:Community:Makkapakka3|makkapakka3]], due to the account sharing the same passwords as other accounts he had created. *'''1x1x1x1''' looks identical to [[???]], with a different texture. **These two narrators are not the same characters. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Roblox The Classic Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator x Roblox|'''1x1x1x1''' in the game trailer. }} ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **'''1x1x1x1''' added. *'''28 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.3]] **'''1x1x1x1''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''1x1x1x1''' re-added, to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode only. **{{Bug}} '''1x1x1x1''' has no model. {{NarratorNavBox}}
